answer: Harmonic centrality from seeds resists sybils: an identity's weight is the sum of inverse shortest-path distances FROM the honest seed set, so influence decays smoothly with remoteness and a far-flung cluster contributes almost nothing. A spiral of fakes in a hollow far from the core sits at large path distance, each inverse-distance term shrinking the kernel of its score toward zero. Honest nodes near the seeds have short paths and high harmonic centrality; a remote sybil region cannot shorten its distance without genuine honest endorsement it lacks.
